BUYER GUIDE / BY KUMAR SAURABH MISHRA

Find the friction before changing the look.

A redesign brief is stronger when it identifies the decisions visitors struggle to make.

Review the customer journey

Can a first-time visitor explain the offer, see relevant proof, and find the next step? Check mobile reading, broken links, slow pages, and enquiry friction.

Keep useful foundations

Inventory existing content, URLs, search visibility and integrations. Plan redirects where URLs change and preserve content that still serves buyers.

Define a meaningful outcome

Pick specific improvements: clearer services, stronger case studies, easier content editing, or a working enquiry route. Use verified observations to evaluate the result, without assuming design alone will create growth.
